verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party Device Authorization plugin that implements the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) code issuance and approval flow. It explicitly targets CLI applications, and the docs note the flow can be tested with the Better Auth CLI. That covers the core of authenticating CLIs without pasting long-lived secrets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/AI-agent use beyond CLIs and limited-input devices, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the device flow working in practice.
